title: Verify US incident entries against primary sources
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. docs/research/incidents.md lists 26 incidents; few are 'Verified (primary)'. US state agencies (FL FDACS, CA DOSH, NY DOL, OH Dept. of Agriculture, CO, ME, WI, PA) publish or release reports.
objective: Upgrade US entries to 'Verified (primary)' where a regulator, court or official report can be found online, correct any facts that conflict, and list what remains.
acceptanceCriteria: Each upgraded entry links the primary document
No upgrade without a primary source; corrections noted in the entry
Table of remaining US entries with the agency that holds the record
Every factual claim has a cited, working source link; estimates are labelled as estimates
